question: Are scholarships available?
answer: Yes. After registration, CUIMS gives you the option to apply for a scholarship. The official Chandigarh University scholarship page (2026-27) lists several schemes: the CUCET Scholarship, the CUET Scholarship (fee benefit by CUET score), merit scholarships based on 12th marks, other concessions (for example single girl child, siblings, old student, teacher's ward, armed forces families, orphan and single parent), a CGPA-based scholarship, and special schemes such as Kalpana Chawla, Shaheed Captain Vikram Batra, Ladakh Merit and Cultural Achievers. Which one applies to you depends on your course and admission route. Details can change during the year, so confirm with the university. Source: https://www.cuchd.in/scholarship/
keywords: scholarship scholarships types categories kinds offered available concession schemes apply financial aid fee waiver discount

question: What is the difference between CUCET and CUET scholarship?
answer: They are two separate schemes on the official page. The CUCET Scholarship is for CUCET recipients and must be renewed every year; the page does not publish a CUCET percentage table. The CUET Scholarship depends on your CUET score and gives a fee benefit on the semester fee: 90% and above gets 50%, 85% to 89.99% gets 30%, 80% to 84.99% gets 15%, and 70% to 79.99% gets 10%, limited to 10% of seats in each course. Which one you hold depends on how you were admitted. Source: https://www.cuchd.in/scholarship/
keywords: difference cucet cuet scholarship compare types score

question: How do I keep my CUCET scholarship every year?
answer: According to the official page, the scholarship is for the entire duration of the program but subject to mandatory meeting of set norms, and CUCET scholarship recipients must apply for renewal every year. The renewal norms listed are: 7.5 CGPA at the end of each year, no indiscipline, and no E, F or I grade in any subject each year. The scholarship is discontinued if there is any case of indiscipline at any point of time. The norms are reviewed every year. Source: https://www.cuchd.in/scholarship/
keywords: renew renewal keep retain continue maintain cgpa 7.5 cucet scholarship every year

question: Will I lose my scholarship if I get a backlog?
answer: The official page does not use the word backlog. For the CUCET Scholarship, the listed renewal norms include 7.5 CGPA at the end of each year and no E, F or I grade in any subject each year. For the CUET Scholarship, the continuation condition is 7.5 CGPA in the first chance with no E, F, I or Not Qualified grade. So an E, F or I grade is a listed condition that can affect your scholarship. The page does not say how re-attempts or supplementary exams are treated, or exactly what happens after such a grade, so I cannot say it is automatic. Please confirm with your department or the university scholarship office before relying on this. Source: https://www.cuchd.in/scholarship/
